item.title: The 911 Dispatch Sales Tax Starts January 1st
item.description: A new sales tax in Livingston County will go into effect on January 1st. Presiding Commissioner Ed Douglas says this tax was approved by voters. Begins on January 1st to support 911 Dispatch. The tax will support the Central Dispatch Board and Dispatch services for law enforcement, EMS, and fire services.

item.title: First Grundy County Female Deputy
item.description: The Grundy County Sheriff’s Department has its first female deputy. Carly Taul was sworn in at the Grundy County Courthouse by Grundy County Associate Judge Carrie Lamm Clark. Taul previously worked for the Grundy County Sheriff’s Office as a Detention Officer and later as a Trenton Police Department Communications Officer.
